text:
Ellen (Partnerships): idea pitch bulb - single private-offer that bundles HW + SI + managed service, with a clearest seller-credit split and an auto-renew signal. Need to make it simple for sales but exact for finance/ops.
Jon (Sales): sounds good. Sales asks: 1) one offer URL, 2) clear payout schedule for partner, 3) small onboarding accelerator to help SI PoC cashflow.
Ravi (Finance): finance guardrails: every partner payout must map to a GL code and monthly reconciliation row. we need provisional vs final payout flags and a reversal window (suggest 120d). also want an explicit "withheld_escrow" column in exports.
Maya (Eng-Billing): technically doable. will add fields to private-offer payload: `seller_allocation`, `escrow_policy`, `milestone_hooks`. also need usage events to include `offer_line_id` and `seller_id`. creating ticket INF-3997.
ops-bot: INF-3997 created - "offer-level escrow + seller allocation + usage attribution" assigned to eng-billing.
Liam (Field Ops): ops: gating milestones should be automated. propose: (A) deployment smoke test pass, (B) SI enablement signoff, (C) 30-day active usage >= threshold. credits vest monthly but release tied to milestone A. clawback if milestone A fails within 90d.
Ellen (Partnerships): draft allocation tiers i sketched: small: 40k/mo -> 10% list disc + 7% seller credit (monthly vest); mid: 120k/mo -> 18% list + 18% seller-credit (split 50% onboarding / 30% usage / 20% renewal); enterprise: 400k+ -> 25% list + 25% seller-credit + co-marketing fund. upfront accelerator: optional 5% month1, convertible post-deploy.
Jon (Sales): prefer accelerator labeled `adoption_accel` and shown on offer as non-refundable until deployment verified then auto-convert to seller credit. keeps sales language simple.
Ravi (Finance): `adoption_accel` must be a liability line until conversion. monthly export format: `offer_id, month, total_usage, provisional_hw_alloc, provisional_si_alloc, withheld_escrow, released_amount, clawback_amount, gl_code_hw, gl_code_si`.
Maya (Eng-Billing): plan: 1) extend usage schema for `offer_line_id` + `seller_tag`, 2) emit provisional ledger entries at month-end, 3) add API `POST /escrow/release` triggered by milestone webhook. will draft RFC.
Liam (Field Ops): can we add a retention routing rule? when month velocity <60% for 2 months -> route to retention queue; when >=80% for 3 of 4 months -> auto-create renewal private-offer and send one-touch accept link to AM.
Maya (Eng-Billing): routing rules supported. will include `velocity_window` config on offer metadata and webhook for alerts.
Ellen (Partnerships): sample simple private-offer snippet for customers (high-level):
````
POST /private_offers
{
  "offer_id": "po-2024-9001",
  "lines": [{"line_id":"l1","sku":"hw-X","price":40000,"seller":"hw_inc"},{"line_id":"l2","sku":"si-onboard","price":8000,"seller":"si_co"}],
  "seller_allocation": [{"seller":"hw_inc","pct":70},{"seller":"si_co","pct":30}],
  "adoption_accel_pct": 5,
  "escrow_policy": "monthly_vest_release_on_milestone",
  "velocity_window": {"renewal_threshold_pct":80,"months_required":3,"retention_alert_pct":60,"retention_months":2}
}
````
Jon (Sales): clean. add `gl_tags` to each line for finance.
Ravi (Finance): yes `gl_tags` required. also request reconciliation CSV endpoint for month-end exports.
Maya (Eng-Billing): will add `gl_tags` and a `/reconciliation/export` endpoint. INF-3997 subtask INF-3997-1 created for export.
ops-bot: INF-3997-1 created - "reconciliation export + gl_tagging".
Ellen (Partnerships): owners: Jon -> sales collateral + AM playbook; Liam -> ops checklist + milestone tests; Maya -> RFC + INF-3997; Ravi -> reconciliation spec. target: internal pilot with 1 HW & 1 SI partner in 5 weeks.
Jon (Sales): will draft single-offer demo and seller-facing FAQ.
Liam (Field Ops): will mock webhook payloads and dashboard tile for Console: escrowed / releasable / released.
Maya (Eng-Billing): RFC will be in #eng-billing by Wed.
Ellen (Partnerships): thanks everyone. ping me for any blockers. :rocket:
